zh: 您好，我上週在官網買的藍牙耳機左耳沒有聲音，已經重新配對三次還是一樣，請問可以換貨嗎？
en: Hi, the left earbud of the Bluetooth earphones I bought on your website last week has no sound. I have re-paired them three times and it is still the same. Can I get a replacement?

zh: 訂單編號 A20391 顯示已出貨五天，但物流查詢一直停在轉運中心，請幫我確認包裹在哪裡。
en: Order A20391 shows it shipped five days ago, but tracking has been stuck at the transfer center. Please check where my package is.

zh: 我的信用卡同一筆訂單被扣款兩次，金額都是 2,490 元，請盡快退還多扣的那一筆。
en: My credit card was charged twice for the same order, NT$2,490 each time. Please refund the duplicate charge as soon as possible.

zh: 智慧手錶充電時背面會發燙，充不到一半就自動斷電，保固還在，要怎麼送修？
en: The back of my smartwatch gets hot while charging and it cuts off before reaching half. It is still under warranty. How do I send it in for repair?

zh: 請問你們的行動電源可以帶上飛機嗎？容量是 20000mAh，想確認一下規定。
en: Can I bring your power bank on a plane? It is 20000mAh and I want to check the rules.

zh: 我忘記會員密碼，重設密碼的信一直沒收到，垃圾郵件匣也找過了。
en: I forgot my member password and never received the reset email. I have checked the spam folder too.

zh: 電熱水壺顏色和網頁照片差很多，還沒拆封，想要退貨，請問運費誰付？
en: The electric kettle's color is very different from the photo on the website. It is unopened and I want to return it. Who pays for shipping?

zh: 掃地機器人今天早上開始一直原地打轉，還發出焦味，我已經先拔掉電源了，這樣安全嗎？
en: Since this morning my robot vacuum keeps spinning in place and smells like something burning. I have unplugged it already. Is that safe?

zh: 可以把收件地址從台北改到新竹嗎？訂單還沒出貨。
en: Can I change the delivery address from Taipei to Hsinchu? The order has not shipped yet.

zh: 這款筆電散熱座適合 16 吋的筆電嗎？風扇聲音大不大？
en: Does this laptop cooling pad fit a 16-inch laptop? Is the fan loud?

zh: 我用分期付款買了耳機，但帳單上顯示的是一次付清，是不是設定錯了？
en: I bought the earphones in installments, but my statement shows a one-time payment. Was it set up wrong?

zh: 收到的行動電源外殼有裂痕，盒子看起來也被壓過，可以直接換一個新的嗎？
en: The power bank I received has a cracked case and the box looks crushed. Can I just get a new one?

zh: 我的會員帳號好像被盜用了，收到一封不是我下的訂單確認信，請馬上幫我凍結帳號。
en: My member account seems to have been hacked. I got an order confirmation for an order I did not place. Please freeze my account immediately.

zh: 耳機的充電盒蓋子關不緊，耳機放進去不會充電，請問維修要多久？
en: The lid of the earphone charging case does not close properly, so the earbuds do not charge. How long does a repair take?

zh: 智慧手錶可以在游泳時戴嗎？防水等級是多少？
en: Can I wear the smartwatch while swimming? What is its water resistance rating?

zh: 物流顯示已送達，可是我家管理室說沒有收到任何包裹。
en: Tracking says it was delivered, but my building's front desk says no package arrived.

zh: 請問可以開公司抬頭的電子發票嗎？統一編號要填在哪裡？
en: Can I get an e-invoice with my company name? Where do I enter the tax ID number?

zh: 不是不喜歡這支手錶，是錶帶太短戴不上，可以只換錶帶嗎？
en: It is not that I dislike this watch; the strap is too short to wear. Can I exchange just the strap?

zh: 掃地機器人的邊刷斷了一根，請問有賣替換零件嗎？
en: One side brush of my robot vacuum broke. Do you sell replacement parts?

zh: 我想把會員帳號綁定的手機號碼換成新的號碼，要怎麼操作？
en: I want to change the phone number linked to my member account to a new number. How do I do that?

zh: 電熱水壺有沒有保溫功能？可以設定 80 度嗎？
en: Does the electric kettle have a keep-warm function? Can I set it to 80 degrees?

zh: 這是要送給客戶的禮物，明天下午前一定要到，現在還沒出貨，可以加急嗎？
en: This is a gift for a client and must arrive before tomorrow afternoon. It has not shipped yet. Can you expedite it?

zh: 退貨已經寄回兩週了，退款還沒有入帳，請幫我查一下進度。
en: I sent the return back two weeks ago and the refund has not arrived. Please check the status.

zh: 筆電散熱座插上 USB 後風扇不會轉，換了兩台電腦都一樣。
en: The laptop cooling pad's fan does not spin when plugged into USB. Same on two different computers.

zh: 我買錯顏色了，想把黑色的耳機換成白色的，還沒有使用過。
en: I bought the wrong color and want to exchange the black earphones for white ones. I have not used them.

zh: 行動電源可以同時幫手機和平板充電嗎？輸出功率是多少？
en: Can the power bank charge a phone and a tablet at the same time? What is the output power?

zh: 登入時一直顯示驗證碼錯誤，可是我是照簡訊輸入的。
en: When I log in it keeps saying the verification code is wrong, but I typed it exactly as in the text message.

zh: 行動電源鼓起來了，外殼已經變形，放在家裡會不會有危險？要怎麼處理？
en: The power bank has swollen and the case is deformed. Is it dangerous to keep at home? What should I do?

zh: 請問可以超商取貨嗎？我白天不在家。
en: Can I pick it up at a convenience store? I am not home during the day.

zh: 結帳時折價券沒有折抵，實際付款比活動價多了 300 元。
en: The coupon was not applied at checkout, so I paid NT$300 more than the promotional price.

zh: 掃地機器人用了三天就無法開機，七天鑑賞期內，想直接退貨退款。
en: The robot vacuum stopped turning on after three days. It is within the seven-day return period and I want a full refund.

zh: 智慧手錶支援 iPhone 嗎？可以收 LINE 通知嗎？
en: Does the smartwatch support iPhone? Can it receive LINE notifications?

zh: 電熱水壺水煮開了不會自動跳停，一直滾，我不敢再用了。
en: The electric kettle does not switch off after the water boils; it keeps boiling. I am afraid to use it again.

zh: 請問會員點數什麼時候會到期？在哪裡可以查？
en: When do my member points expire? Where can I check them?

zh: 收到的箱子裡只有充電線，耳機本體沒有在裡面。
en: The box I received only had the charging cable; the earphones themselves were not inside.

zh: 我取消訂單了，但是信用卡還是被扣款，而且金額比訂單多，請立刻處理。
en: I canceled the order but my credit card was still charged, and for more than the order total. Please handle this immediately.

zh: 先退款再寄回可以嗎？還是一定要先寄回再退款？
en: Can you refund first and I send it back after? Or must I send it back first and then get the refund?

zh: 手錶螢幕有一條細細的刮痕，這種在保固範圍內嗎？
en: The watch screen has a thin scratch. Is that covered by the warranty?

zh: 掃地機器人可以用手機 App 設定清掃時間嗎？
en: Can I schedule cleaning times for the robot vacuum with the phone app?

zh: 我同時有兩個會員帳號，想把點數合併到同一個帳號。
en: I have two member accounts and want to merge the points into one account.
